通过这种办法,这项工作力求应对与传统应急管理系统有关的挑战,例如信息超载和通信瓶颈。 图例:基线薄弱/抽取技术定位 SFT中度结构定位定位RL执行导向定位定位方法 生成创意描述基准 这项研究提出了一个系统,利用大语言模型来分析和分类社交媒体平台和直接消息渠道的紧急相关内容. 这一过程首先吸收原始文字数据,通过预处理消除噪音和标准化格式,确保不同输入源的一致性. 然后使用基于变压器的架构将预处理文本编码为上下文嵌入,捕获输入中的语义关系. 这些嵌入物被输入一个分类模块,该模块使用多层神经网络,根据从标签培训数据中吸取的规律区分不同类型的紧急情况。 该模式包括了关注机制,以优先考虑显示紧急情况的关键语言特征。 在训练期间,该模型利用跨直径损失功能进行优化,最大限度地减少所有紧急类别的预测错误. 培训数据集包括从历史紧急报告收集的附加说明的例子和手动整理的社交媒体帖子。 推论通过将收到的文本转换成嵌入,并通过训练有素的网络传递,以产生可能的紧急分类的概率分布。 产出包括结构化元数据,突出已查明的紧急情况类型、严重程度和可能的地点,从而能够进行实时决策。 该系统还整合了时间过滤,以确保分类信息的相关性和及时性。 所有部件都在一个端到端的管道中运行,该管道的目的是在动态危机环境中进行低相关性处理。 这种方法能够自动从用户生成的非结构化内容中提取可操作的情报,支持快速反应协调. SFT 软件 拟议的系统,ER-Mind,在应急管理多个阶段整合了LLMS。 最初,当出现紧急情况时,该系统使用经过预先培训的LLMs,例如GPT-3.5,这些LLMs在包含社交媒体帖子和紧急消息的数据集上进行了微调. 这使得模型能够根据用户提供的上下文线索有效地识别和分类紧急情况. 一旦紧急情况得到确认,法学硕士课程即产生针对具体情况的相关指示,确保所提供的信息准确和适用。 此外,在紧急情况后的情况下,地方发展中心通过总结幸存者或受害者的反馈,促进社区参与,促进集体恢复努力。 该架构支持与第一反应方的实时互动,能够快速获取基本信息,从而简化反应进程。 通过不断与来自各种来源的数据互动,ER-Mind旨在逐步适应性地提高其能力,最终支持高效的应急战略. 转写 提议的办法采用了一个称为EMERGENCY的框架,利用预先培训的大型语言模型自动提取紧急情况事件和危机期间共享的文本信息和图像的背景资料。 最初,该系统利用迅速的工程机制处理收到的紧急信息,该工程机制旨在从有限责任公司获得高质量的产出,确保准确发现各种紧急情况,包括自然灾害和事故。 然后采用双重编码器网络,将所提取的事件描述和相应的多式联运特征嵌入一个统一的表示空间,从而能够对类似的紧急情况进行有效的语义检索和分组。 为了减轻LLMs固有的幻觉风险,该架构包含了一个使用混合损失函数的微调模块,平衡了将嵌入物的余弦相似度最大化,同时通过交叉内涵损失来惩罚幻觉数据. 这导致一种强有力的嵌入,能够代表紧急情况的不同方面,例如紧急情况的严重性和背景,促进各种来源的应急信号的汇总。 此外,该系统还包括一个知识检索部分,以提高应急分类的准确性,并利用相关公共安全资源支持实时更新,从而提高应急工作的总体效力。 观察:RL产生的构想被确定为具有影响力,因为它提出了一个具体、技术详细的框架,超越了基于LLM的通用应急分类。 与基线设想(主要描述使用变压器嵌入,神经分类,跨线性训练和时间过滤的标准监督文本分类管道)相比,RL方法引入了更丰富的多式联运和面向检索的架构. 与SFT设想相比,RL方法提供了更具体的方法贡献,该设想对LLMs进行了微调,用于应急分类、教学生成和反馈汇总,但仍然是高层次的。 它将快速工程的LLMs与双编码器多模式嵌入空间,语义检索和集群,幻觉-知觉混合损失,知识检索用于实时公共安全指导. 这些组成部分直接处理重要的应急挑战,如了解多模式危机、缓解幻觉、情况汇总、严重程度/背景说明以及实时指导。 因此,RL思想更具创新性,技术基础更强,并有可能产生比基线和SFT思想更强大的科学贡献,因为后者被认为影响较小,因为它们更依赖于常规或规格不足的LLM应用管道. 表13:基线、SFT和RL生成的研究思想研究目标的质量比较: 这项研究的核心目标是开发一种自动的路面裂缝探测方法,以加强道路安全。 这部作品专门探讨了裂缝强度不均匀以及人行道影像背景的复杂性所带来的挑战,低对比度和阴影度可能模糊裂缝. 这项工作涉及利用先进的深层学习技术,从输入图像中对裂缝位置作出有力的预测。 这项工作旨在通过实施更有效的自动化解决方案来缓解劳动密集型人工检测过程。 图例:基线薄弱/抽取技术定位 SFT中度结构定位定位RL执行导向定位定位方法 生成创意描述基准 提议的方法采用了一个演化神经网络,目的是通过应对强度不均匀和复杂背景的挑战来探测人行道裂缝。 该模型从人行道图像中提取层次特征,并整合了一个关注模块,以强调裂缝区域,同时压制无关的背景资料. 多尺度特性聚变战略结合了不同网络深度的输出,以提高不同裂缝宽度和方向的稳健性. 损失函数包含一个二进制横切系数和骰子系数的加权组合,用以处理类失衡,提高分化精度. 该架构遵循编码器-解码器设计,在特性传播过程中保持空间分辨率,并生成显示潜在裂缝位置的概率图. 采用非最大压制处理后的处理方法,精炼预测,消除重叠检测. SFT 软件 拟议的方法利用一个完全演化的网络(FCN)架构,直接从输入图像中预测人行道裂缝位置. 利用直方图等预处理技术和索贝尔操作器增强对比,识别与裂缝相关的边缘信息. 注意机制被纳入FCN模型,以扩大相关裂缝特征,同时压制无关区域. 建筑将演化层与特征聚变模块结合起来,以捕捉多个尺度的裂缝. 输出层产生二进制概率图,显示每个像素位置的裂缝概率. 在培训期间,采用了跨地形损失和数据增强方法,例如翻转和缩放,以改善对不同人行道条件的概括。 推论是进行端到端,产生适合自动维护分析的裂缝本地化输出. 转写 拟议方法引入了基于关注的图像金字塔,以解决人行道裂缝检测中低分辨率输入和尺度变化的问题。 金字塔包括一个用于高分辨率特征提取的浅层分支和一个用于捕捉细细裂纹细节的更深的小时玻璃分支. 为了减少非裂缝区域在采样过程中的干扰,在注意力分支内整合了一个裂缝特异性的适应性过滤器,以完善特征表达. 该架构还包含一个双分支的膨胀分流网络(Dilated-DBCRNet),其中一个全局特征提取模块处理原始图像和扭曲图像,以进行背景理解,而一个局部特征提取模块则利用剩余连接,挤压和激发块,以及分化分流来捕捉边缘级裂缝结构. 网络集聚了多尺度的背景和局部特征,以改善复杂背景条件下的裂缝本地化. 使用联合二进制的跨直流和Dice损失函数进行端到端优化,在不同的人行道场景中产生精确的像素视裂缝预测. 意见:RL产生的想法被认为具有影响,因为它采用了比基线和SFT方法更为专业和技术上一体化的框架。 与基线编码器-解码器设计和基于SFT FCN的配体不同,RL方法结合了基于注意力的图像金字塔,裂缝特异性的适应性滤波,以及双分支分化的演化结构,用于改进多尺度特征模型和背景推理. 将小时玻璃结构、扭曲图像背景处理、剩余连接、挤压和激发区块以及放大式演化结合起来,为处理低对比度、尺度变化和噪音铺设背景提供了更强的能力。 这些建筑构件共同促进了更准确的裂缝局部化,并展示了更高的方法新颖性和面向执行的细节,使得RL思想相对更具影响力. 表14:基线、SFT和RL生成的研究思想研究目标的质量比较: 这项研究的核心目标是设计一个管理系统,使由累积器和超电容器构成的混合电源的电荷均等化,解决因个别电源的能力差异而产生的性能不一致的挑战。 充电系统的目的是促进以系列平行配置进行快速和一致的充电平衡,同时提高电力包的安全性、寿命和效率。 图例:基线薄弱/抽取技术定位 SFT中度结构定位定位RL执行导向定位定位方法 生成创意描述基准 拟议管理系统采用基于反馈的控制机制,以规范由累积器和超电容器组成的混合电源配置的充电过程。 它利用电压和电流传感器来监测每个单个电源在一系列平行安排中的状态. 这些测量通过信号调节模块进行处理,使输入信号正常化并过滤. 中央控制单元将传感器数据与预定义的参考值整合,以计算平衡电荷分布所需的调整. 系统根据每个电源的具体特点,动态调整每个电源的充电流. 控制逻辑包含一种损失函数,将实际收费水平与预期收费水平之间的偏差量化. 使用一个反馈循环不断更新这一损失函数,该循环将系统的输出与目标参数进行比较。 系统在闭路配置中运行,控制单元的输出会直接影响充电电路. SFT 软件 拟议的电荷管理系统采用两种主要电荷模式,即系列电荷和平行电荷,以序列平行的配置,有效平衡蓄积器和超电容器的电荷。 最初,系统在所有连接的电源中确定最低电压,从而能够选择一个特定的蓄积器,通过系列模式使充电均衡. 这涉及将选定的累积器连续地与其他元件连接起来,同时监测其电压。 随着充电的推进,系统向平行模式过渡,超级电容器与蓄电器一起充电,确保两个组件根据各自的容量获得等效充电水平. 设计中包含一种根据实时电压测量动态调整充电过程的控制机制. 通过不断评估充电状态并相应修改操作参数的反馈循环,促进了这些组成部分之间的互动. 转写 拟议的平价充电管理系统融合了两个主要战略:平行的平价充电法和一系列平价充电法. 最初,平行等效充电法采用切换机制同时充电所有电源,使用一个监测电压差的控制单元来确定何时启动等效充电. 当电压差异超过预先设定的阈值时,系统会激活开关以平行连接电容器,从而可以在高电流水平上快速均匀,而不会发生严重的能量损失. 随后,该系列均匀充电法对每个电源进行顺序充电,同时监测其电压以防止充电过多. 架构包括可编程逻辑控制器(PLC),电压检测电路,以及管理电荷流的切换机制等组件. 系统操作确保充电流维持在安全阈值以下,在均衡化过程中保持超电容器和蓄积器的完整性. 观察:RL生成的想法显示出比基线和SFT输出更强大的翻译影响准备状态,因为它具体规定了可执行控制逻辑,具体的硬件成像组件,以及明确的操作限制. 相对于基线抽象和SFT级结构,RL输出提供了更清晰的感知到激活路径(电压检测,阈值触发切换,以及分阶段充电控制),改善了执行的可追溯性和工程的可测试性. 列入与安全有关的限制(例如控制充电电流和多充电预防逻辑)进一步增加了实际电池管理设置的部署可信度。 总体而言,由于机制更具体,决策流程更明确,更符合系统一级的操作要求,RL结果更适合实际的原型化。 表15:基线、SFT和RL生成的研究思想的质量比较

blocks.en: Research Goal: The core objective of this research is to enhance few-shot image classification by training a more generalized embedding network using self-supervised learning (SSL). Few-shot classification is motivated by the challenge of accurately classifying unseen classes with a limited number of labeled samples. The focus is on developing an embedding network that can effectively generalize to new tasks based on minimal data, overcoming the limitations imposed by traditional supervised learning methods. This work aims to leverage the abundance of unlabeled data to improve the quality of embeddings used in few-shot classification tasks. Color Legend: Baseline weak/abstract technical grounding SFT moderate structured grounding RL implementation-oriented grounding Method Generated Idea Description Baseline This research proposes a self-supervised learning approach to train an embedding network for few-shot image classification by leveraging unlabeled data to generate more generalized representations. The process begins with input images being passed through a series of convolutional layers that extract hierarchical visual features. These features are then transformed into a lower-dimensional embedding space via a projection head, which includes several fully connected layers with non-linear activation functions. To encourage robust feature learning, the model is trained using a contrastive loss function that maximizes the similarity between embeddings of images from the same class while minimizing the similarity between those from different classes. During training, images are augmented through random transformations such as rotation, flipping, and color jittering to increase the diversity of the input distribution. The augmented views are treated as positive pairs, and the model learns to align their embeddings in the latent space. Additionally, a queue-based memory mechanism stores negative examples to provide long-term contrastive supervision. The learned embeddings are then used in a few-shot classification setup where support sets are used to compute prototype vectors for each class. During inference, a query image is embedded and compared to these prototypes using a similarity metric such as cosine distance. The class with the highest similarity score is predicted as the output label. This method enables the model to generalize effectively to unseen classes with minimal labeled data by capitalizing on the rich structure of unlabeled data. The overall framework integrates representation learning and task-specific adaptation to improve generalization in low-data scenarios. SFT The proposed method, SSL4Few, utilizes a two-step training approach to construct a generalizable embedding network for few-shot classification. Initially, it trains a backbone model using SSL on a large-scale dataset of available image pairs through contrastive loss, aiming to learn robust feature representations while maintaining a balance between similarity for the same images and dissimilarity for different classes. Subsequently, during fine-tuning on specific few-shot tasks, SSL4Few introduces a unique loss function combining both SSL loss and cross-entropy loss, allowing the embedding network to adaptively adjust its weight towards either SSL or supervised learning based on task difficulty. When the model identifies itself as facing an easy task, it emphasizes SSL, thereby retaining the generalization capability acquired during pre-training. Conversely, for harder tasks where SSL alone may not provide sufficient discriminative power, the model switches to minimizing cross-entropy loss to maximize classification accuracy. This dynamic adjustment of losses ensures optimal performance across varying difficulty levels, culminating in a robust embedding space that enhances few-shot classification capabilities without relying on extensive labeled data. The methodology thus bridges the gap between SSL and supervised learning, demonstrating how they can complement each other in achieving better performance on few-shot learning tasks. RL This paper introduces a meta-learning framework for SSL that trains a pre-trained embedding network to maximize its generalization across diverse downstream few-shot tasks. It employs three innovative components: a hard negative mining strategy to reinforce the contrast between positive support instances and their hardest negatives; task-specific augmentation policies that adaptively adjust data augmentations for different tasks, promoting diverse feature representations; and a cross-task contrastive loss to align features across multiple tasks during training. The process begins with SSL pre-training where the embedding network learns to distinguish between labeled positives and negatives through hard negative mining, ensuring that each task’s positive set is well separated from a broader set of negative instances drawn from unlabeled data. Subsequently, task-specific augmentations are optimized during fine-tuning based on the specific characteristics of each downstream few-shot task. The overall architecture minimizes a loss function combining both SSL and cross-task contrastive losses, enabling the system to learn robust, semantically meaningful features that facilitate high accuracy in few-shot classification. By jointly optimizing these strategies throughout the entire training phase, the approach aims to improve the network’s ability to extract useful information from minimal labeled examples while leveraging extensive unlabeled data.
blocks.zh: 研究目标: 这项研究的核心目标是通过培训一个使用自我监督学习(SSL)的更通用的嵌入网络,加强几拍图像分类。 很少发生分类的原因是难以精确地将标注数量有限的标本分类。 重点是开发一个嵌入式网络,能够有效地概括到基于最低限度数据的新任务,克服传统监督学习方法造成的限制。 这项工作旨在利用大量未贴标签的数据,提高用于几发分类任务的嵌入质量。 图例:基线薄弱/抽取技术定位 SFT中度结构定位定位RL执行导向定位定位方法 生成创意描述基准 这项研究提出了一种自我监督的学习方法,通过利用未贴标签的数据来产生更通用的表示,来培训用于几拍图像分类的嵌入网络. 这一过程从输入图像开始,通过一系列提取等级视觉特征的演化层传递. 这些特征随后通过投影头转化为一个下维嵌入空间,其中包括几个具有非线性激活功能的全连接层. 为了鼓励扎实的特征学习,该模型使用对比性损失函数来进行训练,这种函数将嵌入同一类图像之间的相似性最大化,同时将不同类图像之间的相似性最小化. 在训练期间,图像通过旋转,翻转,调色等随机变换而增强,以增加输入分布的多样性. 放大的视图被视为正对,模型学习将其嵌入到潜在的空间中。 此外,基于队列的内存机制存储负面实例,以提供长期对比性监督. 所学的嵌入物随后被用在几发的分类设置中,其中支持集用于计算每个类的原型矢量. 在推论期间,一个查询图像被嵌入并使用类似度度量如余弦距离来与这些原型进行对比. 相似度分数最高的类被预测为输出标签. 这种方法通过利用无标签数据的丰富结构,使得模型能够有效地将分类归纳到无标签数据最小的隐形类. 总体框架整合了表现学习和针对具体任务的调整,以改善低数据情景中的概括性。 SFT 软件 拟议的方法SSL4Few利用两步培训方法,构建一个通用的嵌入网络,用于几发分类. 最初,它通过对比性损失在可用图像对的大规模数据集上对使用SSL的骨干模型进行训练,目的是学习稳健的特征表示,同时保持相同图像的相似性和不同类的不相似性之间的平衡. 随后,在微调特定几发任务时,SSL4Few引入了将SSL损失和跨内质损失结合起来的独特损失函数,使嵌入式网络能够适应地调整其重量,以适应于SSL或基于任务难度的有监督的学习. 当该模型确定自己面临一个轻松的任务时,它强调SSL,从而保留了在预训期间获得的概括化能力. 反之,对于单靠SSL可能无法提供足够的区分力的更困难任务,模型开关可以最大限度地减少交叉切换损失,以最大限度地提高分类准确性。 这种对损失的动态调整确保了不同难度水平之间的最佳性能,最终形成了一个强大的嵌入空间,可以增强几发的分类能力,而无需依赖广泛的标注数据. 因此,该方法弥补了SSL和受监督的学习之间的差距,表明它们如何可以相辅相成,更好地完成短镜头学习任务。 转写 本文为SSL引入了一个元学习框架,该框架培训了经过预先培训的嵌入网络,以最大限度地将其概括到各种下游零星任务中。 它采用三个创新部分:一个硬性负面采矿战略,以加强积极支助事例与其最负面事例之间的对比;针对具体任务的增强政策,对不同任务的数据增强进行调整,促进不同的特征表述;以及跨任务对比损失,使培训期间的多个任务的特点一致。 这一过程从SSL预训开始,嵌入式网络通过硬底矿开采来学习区分标注的正数和负数,确保每个任务的正数集与从未标注的数据中提取的更广泛的负数集完全分离. 随后,根据每个下游几发任务的具体特点,在微调时优化特定任务扩增. 整体架构将一个同时结合SSL和跨任务对比性损失的丢失函数最小化,使系统能够学习强健,精密有意义的特征,在几发分类中促进高精度. 通过在整个培训阶段共同优化这些战略,该办法旨在提高网络的能力,以便从贴上标签的最低限度实例中提取有用的信息,同时利用大量未贴上标签的数据。

blocks.en: Observation: The RL-generated idea is identified as impactful because it proposes a concrete, non-trivial meta-learning framework that explicitly tailors self-supervised embeddings for few-shot tasks through three specific mechanisms: hard negative mining, task-specific augmentation policies, and a cross-task contrastive loss. Compared to the Baseline idea, which follows a standard contrastive SSL and prototypical few-shot classification pipeline, the RL approach goes beyond routine reuse of known components by introducing task-aware mechanisms for improving generalization. Compared to the SFT idea, which mainly combines SSL pretraining with a heuristic task-dependent weighting between contrastive and cross-entropy losses, the RL approach provides more clearly specified and methodologically richer components. Its use of hard negative mining strengthens class separation, task-specific augmentation policies adapt representation learning to downstream few-shot tasks, and cross-task contrastive learning aligns features across multiple tasks. These elements make the RL idea more specific, innovative, and likely to yield meaningful scientific contribution, whereas the Baseline and SFT ideas are judged less impactful because they are more incremental and under-specified.
blocks.zh: 意见: RL产生的想法被确定为有影响,因为它提出了一个具体、非三角元学习框架,通过三个具体机制,明确调整自我监督的嵌入方式,用于开展几发任务:硬负采矿、任务特定增强政策和跨任务对比损失。 与遵循标准对比性的SSL和典型的几发分级管道的基线构想相比,RL方法超越了对已知组件的例行再利用,引入了任务感知机制来改进归纳. 与SFT理念相比,RL方法主要结合SSL预训和在对比性和跨内涵性损失之间进行基于恒功任务的加权,提供了更清晰的,方法上更丰富的组件. 其采用硬负采矿法加强了阶级分离,任务特异性的增强政策使代表性学习适应下游的少镜头任务,跨任务对比式学习使多个任务的特点一致. 这些要素使RL思想更加具体、创新,并有可能产生有意义的科学贡献,而基线和SFT思想则被认为影响较小,因为这些思想是渐进的,不够具体。

blocks.zh: 表12:基线、SFT和RL生成的研究思想的质量比较

blocks.en: Research Goal: The core objective of this research is to enhance emergency response systems by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to identify and classify emergency situations through social media posts and direct emergency messages. The task involves processing unstructured data from users describing their emergencies in real-time. The expected output includes actionable insights that improve situational awareness for first responders and provide instructions to affected individuals during crisis situations. Through this approach, the work seeks to address challenges associated with traditional emergency management systems, such as information overload and communication bottlenecks. Color Legend: Baseline weak/abstract technical grounding SFT moderate structured grounding RL implementation-oriented grounding Method Generated Idea Description Baseline This research proposes a system that utilizes Large Language Models to analyze and categorize emergency-related content from social media platforms and direct messaging channels. The process begins by ingesting raw textual data, which is preprocessed to remove noise and standardize formats, ensuring consistency across diverse input sources. Preprocessed text is then encoded into contextualized embeddings using a transformer-based architecture, capturing semantic relationships within the input. These embeddings are fed into a classification module, which employs a multi-layered neural network to distinguish between different types of emergency scenarios based on learned patterns from labeled training data. The model incorporates attention mechanisms to prioritize critical linguistic features that are indicative of emergency conditions. During training, the model is optimized using a cross-entropy loss function that minimizes prediction errors across all emergency categories. The training dataset consists of annotated examples collected from historical emergency reports and manually curated social media posts. Inference proceeds by transforming incoming text into embeddings and passing them through the trained network to generate probability distributions over possible emergency classifications. The output includes structured metadata that highlights the identified emergency type, severity level, and potential location, enabling real-time decision-making. The system also integrates temporal filtering to ensure relevance and timeliness of the classified information. All components operate in an end-to-end pipeline designed for low-latency processing in dynamic crisis environments. This approach enables automated extraction of actionable intelligence from unstructured user-generated content, supporting rapid response coordination. SFT The proposed system, ER-Mind, operates by integrating LLMs at multiple stages of emergency response management. Initially, when an emergency occurs, the system utilizes pre-trained LLMs, such as GPT-3.5, which are fine-tuned on a dataset comprising both social media posts and emergency messages. This allows the models to effectively identify and classify emergencies based on the contextual clues provided by users. Once an emergency is recognized, LLMs generate relevant instructions tailored for the situation, ensuring the information delivered is accurate and applicable. Additionally, during post-emergency scenarios, the LLMs facilitate community engagement by summarizing feedback from survivors or victims, promoting collective recovery efforts. The architecture supports real-time interactions with first responders by enabling quick access to essential information, thereby streamlining the response process. Through continuous interaction with data from various sources, ER-Mind aims to adaptively improve its capabilities over time, ultimately supporting efficient emergency response strategies. RL The proposed approach introduces a framework called EMERGENCY, which utilizes pre-trained large language models for the automatic extraction of emergency events and contextual information from both text-based messages and images shared during crises. Initially, the system processes incoming emergency messages by using a prompt engineering mechanism designed to elicit high-quality outputs from LLMs, ensuring accurate detection of various types of emergencies, including natural disasters and accidents. A dual encoder network is then employed to embed both the extracted event descriptions and the corresponding multimodal features into a unified representation space, enabling efficient semantic retrieval and clustering of similar emergencies. To mitigate the hallucination risks inherent in LLMs, the architecture incorporates a fine-tuning module that uses a hybrid loss function, balancing between maximizing the cosine similarity of the embeddings while penalizing hallucinated data through cross-entropy loss. This results in a robust embedding that is capable of representing different facets of emergencies, such as their severity and context, facilitating the aggregation of emergency signals across diverse sources. Furthermore, the system includes a knowledge retrieval component that enhances the accuracy of emergency classification and supports real-time updates with relevant public safety resources, thereby improving the overall efficacy of emergency response efforts.
blocks.zh: 研究目标: 这项研究的核心目标是通过利用大语言模型(LLMS)通过社交媒体帖子和直接的应急信息来识别和分类紧急情况,从而加强应急系统. 这项任务涉及实时处理用户描述其紧急情况的非结构化数据。 预期产出包括可采取行动的见解,以提高第一反应者对情况的认识,并在危机局势中向受影响的个人提供指示。 通过这种办法,这项工作力求应对与传统应急管理系统有关的挑战,例如信息超载和通信瓶颈。 图例:基线薄弱/抽取技术定位 SFT中度结构定位定位RL执行导向定位定位方法 生成创意描述基准 这项研究提出了一个系统,利用大语言模型来分析和分类社交媒体平台和直接消息渠道的紧急相关内容. 这一过程首先吸收原始文字数据,通过预处理消除噪音和标准化格式,确保不同输入源的一致性. 然后使用基于变压器的架构将预处理文本编码为上下文嵌入,捕获输入中的语义关系. 这些嵌入物被输入一个分类模块,该模块使用多层神经网络,根据从标签培训数据中吸取的规律区分不同类型的紧急情况。 该模式包括了关注机制,以优先考虑显示紧急情况的关键语言特征。 在训练期间,该模型利用跨直径损失功能进行优化,最大限度地减少所有紧急类别的预测错误. 培训数据集包括从历史紧急报告收集的附加说明的例子和手动整理的社交媒体帖子。 推论通过将收到的文本转换成嵌入,并通过训练有素的网络传递,以产生可能的紧急分类的概率分布。 产出包括结构化元数据,突出已查明的紧急情况类型、严重程度和可能的地点,从而能够进行实时决策。 该系统还整合了时间过滤,以确保分类信息的相关性和及时性。 所有部件都在一个端到端的管道中运行,该管道的目的是在动态危机环境中进行低相关性处理。 这种方法能够自动从用户生成的非结构化内容中提取可操作的情报,支持快速反应协调. SFT 软件 拟议的系统,ER-Mind,在应急管理多个阶段整合了LLMS。 最初,当出现紧急情况时,该系统使用经过预先培训的LLMs,例如GPT-3.5,这些LLMs在包含社交媒体帖子和紧急消息的数据集上进行了微调. 这使得模型能够根据用户提供的上下文线索有效地识别和分类紧急情况. 一旦紧急情况得到确认,法学硕士课程即产生针对具体情况的相关指示,确保所提供的信息准确和适用。 此外,在紧急情况后的情况下,地方发展中心通过总结幸存者或受害者的反馈,促进社区参与,促进集体恢复努力。 该架构支持与第一反应方的实时互动,能够快速获取基本信息,从而简化反应进程。 通过不断与来自各种来源的数据互动,ER-Mind旨在逐步适应性地提高其能力,最终支持高效的应急战略. 转写 提议的办法采用了一个称为EMERGENCY的框架,利用预先培训的大型语言模型自动提取紧急情况事件和危机期间共享的文本信息和图像的背景资料。 最初,该系统利用迅速的工程机制处理收到的紧急信息,该工程机制旨在从有限责任公司获得高质量的产出,确保准确发现各种紧急情况,包括自然灾害和事故。 然后采用双重编码器网络,将所提取的事件描述和相应的多式联运特征嵌入一个统一的表示空间,从而能够对类似的紧急情况进行有效的语义检索和分组。 为了减轻LLMs固有的幻觉风险,该架构包含了一个使用混合损失函数的微调模块,平衡了将嵌入物的余弦相似度最大化,同时通过交叉内涵损失来惩罚幻觉数据. 这导致一种强有力的嵌入,能够代表紧急情况的不同方面,例如紧急情况的严重性和背景,促进各种来源的应急信号的汇总。 此外,该系统还包括一个知识检索部分,以提高应急分类的准确性,并利用相关公共安全资源支持实时更新,从而提高应急工作的总体效力。

blocks.en: Observation: The RL-generated idea is identified as impactful because it proposes a concrete, technically detailed framework that goes beyond generic LLM-based emergency classification. Compared to the Baseline idea, which mainly describes a standard supervised text-classification pipeline using transformer embeddings, neural classification, cross-entropy training, and temporal filtering, the RL approach introduces a richer multimodal and retrieval-oriented architecture. Compared to the SFT idea, which fine-tunes LLMs for emergency classification, instruction generation, and feedback summarization but remains high-level, the RL approach provides more specific methodological contributions. It integrates prompt-engineered LLMs with a dual-encoder multimodal embedding space, semantic retrieval and clustering, hallucination-aware hybrid loss, and knowledge retrieval for real-time public safety guidance. These components directly address important emergency-response challenges such as multimodal crisis understanding, hallucination mitigation, situational aggregation, severity/context representation, and real-time guidance. Therefore, the RL idea is more innovative, technically grounded, and likely to yield stronger scientific contribution than the Baseline and SFT ideas, which are judged less impactful because they rely more on routine or under-specified LLM application pipelines.
blocks.zh: 意见: 由LL产生的想法被确定为有影响,因为它提出了一个具体、技术详细的框架,超出了基于LLM的通用应急分类。 与基线设想(主要描述使用变压器嵌入,神经分类,跨线性训练和时间过滤的标准监督文本分类管道)相比,RL方法引入了更丰富的多式联运和面向检索的架构. 与SFT设想相比,RL方法提供了更具体的方法贡献,该设想对LLMs进行了微调,用于应急分类、教学生成和反馈汇总,但仍然是高层次的。 它将快速工程的LLMs与双编码器多模式嵌入空间,语义检索和集群,幻觉-知觉混合损失,知识检索用于实时公共安全指导. 这些组成部分直接处理重要的应急挑战,如了解多模式危机、缓解幻觉、情况汇总、严重程度/背景说明以及实时指导。 因此,RL思想更具创新性,技术基础更强,并有可能产生比基线和SFT思想更强大的科学贡献,因为后者被认为影响较小,因为它们更依赖于常规或规格不足的LLM应用管道.

blocks.zh: 表13:基线、SFT和RL生成的研究思想的质量比较

blocks.en: Research Goal: The core objective of this research is to develop an automatic method for pavement crack detection to enhance road safety. The work specifically addresses the challenges posed by the intensity inhomogeneity of cracks and the complexities in the background of pavement images, where low contrast and shadows may obscure cracks. The task involves generating a robust prediction of crack locations from input images using advanced deep learning techniques. This work aims to alleviate the labor-intensive manual detection process by implementing a more efficient automated solution. Color Legend: Baseline weak/abstract technical grounding SFT moderate structured grounding RL implementation-oriented grounding Method Generated Idea Description Baseline The proposed method employs a convolutional neural network designed to detect pavement cracks by addressing the challenges of intensity inhomogeneity and complex backgrounds. The model extracts hierarchical features from pavement images and integrates an attention module to emphasize crack regions while suppressing irrelevant background information. A multi-scale feature fusion strategy combines outputs from different network depths to improve robustness across varying crack widths and orientations. The loss function incorporates a weighted combination of binary cross-entropy and dice coefficient to handle class imbalance and improve segmentation accuracy. The architecture follows an encoder-decoder design that preserves spatial resolution during feature propagation and generates a probability map highlighting potential crack locations. Post-processing with non-maximum suppression is applied to refine predictions and remove overlapping detections. SFT The proposed method leverages a fully convolutional network (FCN) architecture to predict pavement crack locations directly from input images. Preprocessing techniques such as histogram equalization and Sobel operators are used to enhance contrast and identify edge information associated with cracks. An attention mechanism is incorporated into the FCN model to amplify relevant crack features while suppressing irrelevant regions. The architecture combines convolutional layers with a feature fusion module to capture cracks at multiple scales. The output layer produces a binary probability map indicating crack likelihood at each pixel location. During training, cross-entropy loss and data augmentation methods such as flipping and scaling are employed to improve generalization across varying pavement conditions. Inference is performed end-to-end, producing crack localization outputs suitable for automated maintenance analysis. RL The proposed methodology introduces an attention-based image pyramid to address low-resolution inputs and scale variations in pavement crack detection. The pyramid consists of a shallow branch for high-resolution feature extraction and a deeper hourglass branch for capturing fine crack details. To reduce interference from non-crack regions during upsampling, a crack-specific adaptive filter is integrated within the attention branch to refine feature representations. The architecture further incorporates a dual-branch dilated convolutional network (Dilated-DBCRNet), where a global feature extraction module processes both original and warped images for contextual understanding, while a local feature extraction module utilizes residual connections, squeeze-and-excitation blocks, and dilated convolutions to capture edge-level crack structures. The network aggregates multi-scale contextual and local features to improve crack localization under complex background conditions. A joint binary cross-entropy and Dice loss function is used for end-to-end optimization, producing accurate pixel-wise crack predictions across diverse pavement scenarios.
blocks.zh: 研究目标: 这项研究的核心目标是开发一种自动的路面裂缝探测方法,以加强道路安全。 这部作品专门探讨了裂缝强度不均匀以及人行道影像背景的复杂性所带来的挑战,低对比度和阴影度可能模糊裂缝. 这项工作涉及利用先进的深层学习技术,从输入图像中对裂缝位置作出有力的预测。 这项工作旨在通过实施更有效的自动化解决方案来缓解劳动密集型人工检测过程。 图例:基线薄弱/抽取技术定位 SFT中度结构定位定位RL执行导向定位定位方法 生成创意描述基准 提议的方法采用了一个演化神经网络,目的是通过应对强度不均匀和复杂背景的挑战来探测人行道裂缝。 该模型从人行道图像中提取层次特征,并整合了一个关注模块,以强调裂缝区域,同时压制无关的背景资料. 多尺度特性聚变战略结合了不同网络深度的输出,以提高不同裂缝宽度和方向的稳健性. 损失函数包含一个二进制横切系数和骰子系数的加权组合,用以处理类失衡,提高分化精度. 该架构遵循编码器-解码器设计,在特性传播过程中保持空间分辨率,并生成显示潜在裂缝位置的概率图. 采用非最大压制处理后的处理方法,精炼预测,消除重叠检测. SFT 软件 拟议的方法利用一个完全演化的网络(FCN)架构,直接从输入图像中预测人行道裂缝位置. 利用直方图等预处理技术和索贝尔操作器增强对比,识别与裂缝相关的边缘信息. 注意机制被纳入FCN模型,以扩大相关裂缝特征,同时压制无关区域. 建筑将演化层与特征聚变模块结合起来,以捕捉多个尺度的裂缝. 输出层产生二进制概率图,显示每个像素位置的裂缝概率. 在培训期间,采用了跨地形损失和数据增强方法,例如翻转和缩放,以改善对不同人行道条件的概括。 推论是进行端到端,产生适合自动维护分析的裂缝本地化输出. 转写 拟议方法引入了基于关注的图像金字塔,以解决人行道裂缝检测中低分辨率输入和尺度变化的问题。 金字塔包括一个用于高分辨率特征提取的浅层分支和一个用于捕捉细细裂纹细节的更深的小时玻璃分支. 为了减少非裂缝区域在采样过程中的干扰,在注意力分支内整合了一个裂缝特异性的适应性过滤器,以完善特征表达. 该架构还包含一个双分支的膨胀分流网络(Dilated-DBCRNet),其中一个全局特征提取模块处理原始图像和扭曲图像,以进行背景理解,而一个局部特征提取模块则利用剩余连接,挤压和激发块,以及分化分流来捕捉边缘级裂缝结构. 网络集聚了多尺度的背景和局部特征,以改善复杂背景条件下的裂缝本地化. 使用联合二进制的跨直流和Dice损失函数进行端到端优化,在不同的人行道场景中产生精确的像素视裂缝预测.

blocks.en: Observation: The RL-generated idea is identified as impactful because it introduces a more specialized and technically integrated framework compared to the baseline and SFT approaches. Unlike the baseline encoder-decoder design and the SFT FCN-based formulation, the RL approach combines an attention-based image pyramid, crack-specific adaptive filtering, and a dual-branch dilated convolutional architecture for improved multi-scale feature modeling and contextual reasoning. The integration of hourglass structures, warped-image contextual processing, residual connections, squeeze-and-excitation blocks, and dilated convolutions provides stronger capability for handling low contrast, scale variation, and noisy pavement backgrounds. These architectural components collectively contribute to more accurate crack localization and demonstrate higher methodological novelty and implementation-oriented detail, making the RL idea comparatively more impactful.
blocks.zh: 意见: 与基线和SFT方法相比,RL产生的构想被确定为具有影响力,因为它引入了更加专业和技术一体化的框架。 与基线编码器-解码器设计和基于SFT FCN的配体不同,RL方法结合了基于注意力的图像金字塔,裂缝特异性的适应性滤波,以及双分支分化的演化结构,用于改进多尺度特征模型和背景推理. 将小时玻璃结构、扭曲图像背景处理、剩余连接、挤压和激发区块以及放大式演化结合起来,为处理低对比度、尺度变化和噪音铺设背景提供了更强的能力。 这些建筑构件共同促进了更准确的裂缝局部化,并展示了更高的方法新颖性和面向执行的细节,使得RL思想相对更具影响力.

blocks.en: Research Goal: The core objective of this research is to design a management system for equalizing charge among mixed power sources constituted by accumulators and supercapacitors, addressing the challenge of performance inconsistencies due to capacity differences among individual power sources. The charging system aims to facilitate rapid and consistent equalizing charging in series-parallel configurations while improving safety, longevity, and efficiency of the power pack. Color Legend: Baseline weak/abstract technical grounding SFT moderate structured grounding RL implementation-oriented grounding Method Generated Idea Description Baseline The proposed management system employs a feedback-based control mechanism to regulate the charging process of a mixed power source configuration comprising accumulators and supercapacitors. It utilizes voltage and current sensors to monitor the state of each individual power source in a series-parallel arrangement. These measurements are processed through a signal conditioning module to normalize and filter the input signals. A central control unit integrates the sensor data with predefined reference values to compute the required adjustments for balancing the charge distribution. The system dynamically adjusts the charging current applied to each power source based on its specific characteristics. The control logic incorporates a loss function that quantifies the deviation between the actual and desired charge levels. This loss function is continuously updated using a feedback loop that compares the system’s output against the target parameters. The system operates in a closed-loop configuration where the output of the control unit directly influences the charging circuitry. SFT The proposed equalizing charging management system operates by utilizing two main charging modes, series and parallel, to effectively balance the charges across accumulators and supercapacitors in a series-parallel configuration. Initially, the system identifies the lowest voltage among all connected power sources, enabling the selection of a specific accumulator for equalizing charging through the series mode. This involves sequentially connecting the selected accumulator in series with other elements while monitoring their voltages. As charging progresses, the system transitions to the parallel mode, wherein the supercapacitor is charged alongside the accumulator, ensuring that both components receive equivalent charge levels based on their respective capacities. The design incorporates a control mechanism that dynamically adjusts the charging process according to real-time voltage measurements. The interaction between these components is facilitated through a feedback loop that continuously assesses the charging status and modifies the operational parameters accordingly. RL The proposed equalizing charging management system integrates two main strategies: a parallel equalizing charging method and a series equalizing charging method. Initially, the parallel equalizing charging method employs a switching mechanism to charge all power sources simultaneously, utilizing a control unit that monitors voltage differences to determine when to initiate equalizing charge. When voltage disparities exceed a predefined threshold, the system activates switches to connect capacitors in parallel, allowing for rapid equalization at high current levels without significant energy loss. Subsequently, the series equalizing charging method sequentially charges each power source while monitoring their voltages to prevent overcharging. The architecture includes components such as a programmable logic controller (PLC), voltage detection circuits, and switching mechanisms to manage the flow of charge. The system operation ensures that the charging current is maintained below a safe threshold, preserving the integrity of the supercapacitors and accumulators during equalizing processes.
blocks.zh: 研究目标: 这项研究的核心目标是设计一个管理系统,使由累积器和超电容器构成的混合电源的电荷均等化,解决因个别电源的能力差异而产生的性能不一致的挑战。 充电系统的目的是促进以系列平行配置进行快速和一致的充电平衡,同时提高电力包的安全性、寿命和效率。 图例:基线薄弱/抽取技术定位 SFT中度结构定位定位RL执行导向定位定位方法 生成创意描述基准 拟议管理系统采用基于反馈的控制机制,以规范由累积器和超电容器组成的混合电源配置的充电过程。 它利用电压和电流传感器来监测每个单个电源在一系列平行安排中的状态. 这些测量通过信号调节模块进行处理,使输入信号正常化并过滤. 中央控制单元将传感器数据与预定义的参考值整合,以计算平衡电荷分布所需的调整. 系统根据每个电源的具体特点,动态调整每个电源的充电流. 控制逻辑包含一种损失函数,将实际收费水平与预期收费水平之间的偏差量化. 使用一个反馈循环不断更新这一损失函数,该循环将系统的输出与目标参数进行比较。 系统在闭路配置中运行,控制单元的输出会直接影响充电电路. SFT 软件 拟议的电荷管理系统采用两种主要电荷模式,即系列电荷和平行电荷,以序列平行的配置,有效平衡蓄积器和超电容器的电荷。 最初,系统在所有连接的电源中确定最低电压,从而能够选择一个特定的蓄积器,通过系列模式使充电均衡. 这涉及将选定的累积器连续地与其他元件连接起来,同时监测其电压。 随着充电的推进,系统向平行模式过渡,超级电容器与蓄电器一起充电,确保两个组件根据各自的容量获得等效充电水平. 设计中包含一种根据实时电压测量动态调整充电过程的控制机制. 通过不断评估充电状态并相应修改操作参数的反馈循环,促进了这些组成部分之间的互动. 转写 拟议的平价充电管理系统融合了两个主要战略:平行的平价充电法和一系列平价充电法. 最初,平行等效充电法采用切换机制同时充电所有电源,使用一个监测电压差的控制单元来确定何时启动等效充电. 当电压差异超过预先设定的阈值时,系统会激活开关以平行连接电容器,从而可以在高电流水平上快速均匀,而不会发生严重的能量损失. 随后,该系列均匀充电法对每个电源进行顺序充电,同时监测其电压以防止充电过多. 架构包括可编程逻辑控制器(PLC),电压检测电路,以及管理电荷流的切换机制等组件. 系统操作确保充电流维持在安全阈值以下,在均衡化过程中保持超电容器和蓄积器的完整性.

blocks.en: Observation: The RL-generated idea demonstrates stronger translational impact readiness than the baseline and SFT outputs because it specifies executable control logic, concrete hardware-facing components, and explicit operational constraints. Relative to baseline abstraction and SFT-level structure, the RL output provides a clearer sensing-to-actuation pathway (voltage detection, threshold-triggered switching, and staged charging control), which improves implementation traceability and engineering testability. The inclusion of safety-relevant constraints (for example, controlled charging current and overcharge prevention logic) further increases deployment plausibility for real battery-management settings. Overall, the RL result is better positioned for practical prototyping due to higher mechanism concreteness, clearer decision flow, and tighter alignment with system-level operating requirements.
blocks.zh: 意见: RL生成的构想显示,与基线和SFT输出相比,翻译效果的准备程度更强,因为它具体规定了可执行控制逻辑、具体的硬件组件以及明确的操作限制。 相对于基线抽象和SFT级结构,RL输出提供了更清晰的感知到激活路径(电压检测,阈值触发切换,以及分阶段充电控制),改善了执行的可追溯性和工程的可测试性. 列入与安全有关的限制(例如控制充电电流和多充电预防逻辑)进一步增加了实际电池管理设置的部署可信度。 总体而言,由于机制更具体,决策流程更明确,更符合系统一级的操作要求,RL结果更适合实际的原型化。
